answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to bond capital to a digital cipher, effectively creating a high cost of entry. To reach the consensus summit, participants must lock assets, ensuring that malicious actors face significant financial liquidation if they behave dishonestly. Much like the dense resilience of cedar, this economic gatekeeping forces attackers to expend capital proportional to their influence, making mass identity fabrication fiscally irrational.
